record.dic_text:
03047 Yada` {yaw-daw'}

源自 03045; 陽性專有名詞

AV - Jada 2; 2

雅大 = "他知道"
1) 一名猶大人, 阿南的兒子, 也是沙買的兄弟, 在族譜裡
   屬耶拉蔑與妻子亞他拉的後代
record.edic_text:
03047 Yada` {yaw-daw'}

from 03045;; n pr m

AV - Jada 2; 2

Jada = "He knows"
1) a Judahite, son of Onam and brother of Shammai, in the genealogy
   of the sons of Jerahmeel by his wife Atarah
